claim: disrobe recognizes and renders every Swift-mangled symbol in the committed SwiftHello Mach-O against pinned in-process output. No external demangler grades output correctness in this gate.
detail: All 37 Swift-mangled symbols in the committed, hash-pinned SwiftHello.original Mach-O appear in LC_SYMTAB and render to their pinned in-process text. LC_SYMTAB fixes the named population and denominator. This is a regression rendering check, not an external-demangler correctness measurement.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-swift-objc/tests/swift_hello_symbol_pin.rs test published_swift_symbol_rendering_is_pinned_to_the_measured_membership, which pins the 37-symbol LC_SYMTAB membership, denominator and in-process rendering text against the committed fixture

oracle.external: the committed SwiftHello Mach-O LC_SYMTAB fixes the named Swift-mangled symbol population; expected renderings are committed regression pins, not an external correctness oracle

title: Pinned Swift symbol renderings from the committed SwiftHello Mach-O
